game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Misty Bog, a misty bog: the forest ranger must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Misty Bog: a misty bog
core_gameplay_loop: In Misty Bog, repeat each round: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones. Each round, bog toads strike the seed vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stones value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the seed vault from bog toads in Misty Bog: keep the stones meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: stones drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Stride Selector
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stride Selector' (Week 5 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Misty Bog'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stones changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Misty Bog.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while stones > 0.
